mapper.insert: insert into task_participants(tenant_id,participant_id,task_id,participant_type,participant_ref_id,participant_role,visibility_level,operation_level,created_at,created_by,version) values(#{participant.tenantId},#{participant.participantId},#{participant.taskId},#{participant.participantType},#{participant.participantRefId},#{participant.participantRole},#{participant.visibilityLevel},#{participant.operationLevel},coalesce(#{participant.createdAt},now()),#{participant.createdBy},#{participant.version}) on conflict (tenant_id,task_id,participant_type,participant_ref_id,participant_role) do nothing
mapper.select: select * from task_participants where tenant_id=#{tenantId} and participant_id=#{participantId}

select * from task_participants where tenant_id=#{tenantId} and task_id=#{taskId} and participant_type=#{participantType} and participant_ref_id=#{participantRefId} and participant_role=#{participantRole} limit 1
select * from task_participants where tenant_id=#{tenantId} and task_id=#{taskId} order by participant_role,created_at limit #{limit}
mapper.delete: delete from task_participants where tenant_id=#{tenantId} and participant_id=#{participantId}
